name: Robot Vision System Calibration Error
description: Calibration error of the robot-mounted camera system. Checks whether visual guidance accuracy is sufficient.

elements.name: Camera-to-Robot Calibration Error
elements.description: Residual hand-eye calibration error. Uncertain due to lens distortion variation and thermal drift.

elements.name: Maximum Calibration Error for Guided Assembly
elements.description: Maximum error for reliable pin-in-hole insertion with vision guidance

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(err_cal) = err_cal if err_cal <= err_cal_max, else ∅
consistency_relations.upr_description: The maximum allowable calibration error guards the hand-eye calibration uncertainty set; residuals above 0.20 mm make vision-guided insertion unreliable.
